Chevis, saw HSI won the 2026 E+E Leader Award for the unified AI-powered EHS platform and is showcasing it at ASSP Safety.

I built a signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?

Chevis, quick follow-up for HSI.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
